# Animaker

> > Animaker is an AI-powered animation and video creation platform enabling users to produce studio-quality videos with minimal effort using AI voice generation, text-to-animation, and pre-built templates.

Animaker serves over 2 million users with a comprehensive suite of video creation tools powered by artificial intelligence. The platform specializes in converting text prompts to animated videos, generating realistic voiceovers in 1800+ voices across 180+ languages, and offering purpose-built makers for specific use cases like marketing, social media, and presentations.

## Core Video Creation Tools

- [Animaker | Animation Maker Powered by AI for Free](https://www.animaker.com): Animaker homepage: AI-powered animation software for studio-quality video creation
- [AI Text Animation Maker](https://www.animaker.com/text-animation-maker): AI text-to-animation tool creating videos from prompts in seconds, used by 30M+ creators
- [AI Explainer Video Maker](https://www.animaker.com/explainer-video-software): AI explainer video generator converting prompts to polished videos instantly
- [YouTube Video Maker](https://www.animaker.com/youtube-video-maker): YouTube video maker with free templates, animations, assets, and royalty-free music
